zh.name: 莲台净界
zh.description: 观音召唤【莲台净界】笼罩全场，范围内敌人会心率，会心伤害降低<color=#02ff00>30%</color>，每<color=#02ff00>2</color>秒释放净化泉水，为全体友军恢复<color=#02ff00>200%</color>攻击力的生命值，【莲台净界】持续<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒

upgrades.zh: 等级2：敌人会心率降低提升至<color=#02ff00>40%</color>
upgrades.en: Enemy Crit Rate reduction increased to 40%.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：敌人会心伤害降低提升至<color=#02ff00>40%</color>
upgrades.en: Enemy Crit DMG reduction increased to 40%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：净化泉水为全体友军恢复生命值提升至<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力
upgrades.en: HP restored to all allies by the purifying spring water increased to 250% ATK.

en.name: Lotus Pure Realm
en.description: Guanyin summons the [Lotus Pure Realm], covering the whole field. Enemies within it have their Crit Rate and Crit DMG reduced by 30%. Every 2s, purifying spring water restores HP equal to 200% ATK to all allies. The [Lotus Pure Realm] lasts 8s.

zh.name: 杨柳净露
zh.description: 对当前会心率最高的敌人释放【杨柳净露】造成<color=#02ff00>250%</color>攻击力的伤害并降低目标<color=#02ff00>30%</color>会心率和攻击力，持续<color=#02ff00>6</color>秒，若目标处于【莲台净界】内，降低会心率和攻击力效果提升至<color=#02ff00>50%</color>

upgrades.zh: 等级2：造成伤害提升至<color=#02ff00>300%</color>攻击力
等级3：降低目标<color=#02ff00>35%</color>会心率和攻击力
upgrades.en: Reduces the target's Crit Rate and ATK by 35%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：若目标处于【莲台净界】内，降低会心率和攻击力效果提升至<color=#02ff00>60%</color>
upgrades.en: If the target is within the [Lotus Pure Realm], the reduction to Crit Rate and ATK is increased to 60%.

en.name: Willow Dew
en.description: Unleashes [Willow Dew] on the enemy with the highest current Crit Rate, dealing 250% ATK as DMG and reducing the target's Crit Rate and ATK by 30% for 6s. If the target is within the [Lotus Pure Realm], the reduction to Crit Rate and ATK is increased to 50%.

zh.name: 本命莲台
zh.description: 战斗开始时，观音获得最多可抵挡自身最大生命值<color=#02ff00>80%</color>伤害的护盾，护盾存在期间自身处于霸体状态，每秒恢复<color=#02ff00>9%</color>最大生命值的护盾，全体友军能量恢复速度提升<color=#02ff00>15%</color>，恢复效果提升<color=#02ff00>15%</color>，该护盾被打破后，观音<color=#02ff00>5</color>秒内受到伤害降低<color=#02ff00>50%</color>，<color=#02ff00>15</color>秒后重新生成

upgrades.zh: 等级2：护盾上限提升至<color=#02ff00>100%</color>最大生命值
upgrades.en: Shield cap increased to 100% of Max HP.

upgrades.zh: 等级3：该护盾每秒恢复<color=#02ff00>11%</color>最大生命值的护盾
upgrades.en: The shield regenerates 11% of Max HP per second.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：全体友军能量恢复速度提升<color=#02ff00>25%</color>，恢复效果提升<color=#02ff00>25%</color>
upgrades.en: All allies' Energy regeneration speed and healing effect increased to 25%.

en.name: Lotus Platform
en.description: At the start of battle, Guanyin gains a shield that absorbs damage up to 80% of her Max HP. While the shield is active, she has Super Armor and regenerates 9% of her Max HP as shield every second. All allies gain 15% Energy regeneration speed and 15% healing effect. When the shield is broken, Guanyin takes 50% less damage for 5s, and the shield regenerates after 15s.

zh.name: 莲花印
zh.description: 观音为全体友方施加一层【莲花印记】（莲花印记：<color=#02ff00>8</color>秒内攻击力提升<color=#02ff00>30%</color>，可抵挡一次会心伤害）

upgrades.zh: 等级2：攻击力增加提升至<color=#02ff00>35%</color>
等级3：持续时间提升至<color=#02ff00>10</color>秒，并额外提高<color=#02ff00>10%</color>会心抵抗率
upgrades.en: Duration increased to 10s, and Crit Resistance is additionally increased by 10%.

upgrades.zh: 等级4：攻击力增加提升至<color=#02ff00>45%</color>

en.name: Lotus Seal
en.description: Guanyin applies 1 stack of [Lotus Mark] to all allies (Lotus Mark: increases ATK by 30% for 8s and blocks one instance of Crit damage).

levels.zh: 【莲台净界】释放时，对全体友军额外添加一层【莲花印记】
levels.en: When [Lotus Pure Realm] is cast, all allies gain an additional stack of [Lotus Mark].

levels.zh: 【莲台净界】释放时，为全体友军额外恢复<color=#02ff00>50</color>点能量
levels.en: When [Lotus Pure Realm] is cast, all allies additionally restore 50 Energy.

levels.zh: 【莲台净界】期间全体友军受到伤害额外降低<color=#02ff00>20%</color>
levels.en: While [Lotus Pure Realm] is active, all allies take an additional 20% less damage.

levels.zh: 【莲台净界】释放净化泉水时，会净化敌人身上所有的增益效果
levels.en: When [Lotus Pure Realm] releases purifying spring water, it also removes all buffs from enemies.
